arxiv-2111-05953.title: Robust Learning via Ensemble Density Propagation in Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-2111-05953.description: Abstract Learning in uncertain, noisy, or adversarial environments is a challenging task for deep neural networks (DNNs). We propose a new theoretically grounded and efficient approach for robust learning that builds upon Bayesian estimation and Variational Inference. We formulate the problem of density propagation through layers of a DNN and solve it using an Ensemble Density Propagation (EnDP) scheme.

arxiv-2203-02716.title: Stability of mixed FEMs for non-selfadjoint indefinite second-order linear elliptic PDEs
arxiv-2203-02716.creator: C. Carstensen, Neela Nataraj, Amiya K. Pani
arxiv-2203-02716.description: Abstract For a well-posed non-selfadjoint indefinite second-order linear elliptic PDE with general coefficients 𝐀 , 𝐛 , γ \mathbf{A},\mathbf{b},\gamma in L ∞ L^{\infty} and symmetric and uniformly positive definite coefficient matrix 𝐀 \mathbf{A} , this paper proves that mixed finite element problems are uniquely solvable and the discrete solutions are uniformly bounded, whenever the underlying shape-regular triangulation is sufficiently fine.

arxiv-2404-16701.title: On the Streaming Complexity of Expander Decomposition
arxiv-2404-16701.creator: Yu Chen, Michael Kapralov, Mikhail Makarov, Davide Mazzali
arxiv-2404-16701.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yu Chen, Michael Kapralov, Mikhail Makarov, Davide Mazzali. In this paper we study the problem of finding ( ϵ , ϕ ) (\epsilon,\phi) -expander decompositions of a graph in the streaming model, in particular for dynamic streams of edge insertions and deletions. The goal is to partition the vertex set so that every component induces a ϕ \phi -expander, while the number of inter-cluster edges is only an ϵ \epsilon fraction of the total volume.

arxiv-2410-14308.description: Abstract In this study, we focus on applying L L -statistics to the high-dimensional one-sample location test problem. Intuitively, an L L -statistic with k k parameters tends to perform optimally when the sparsity level of the alternative hypothesis matches k k .

arxiv-2503-12776.creator: Rico Pohle, Nic Shannon
arxiv-2503-12776.description: Abstract The search for spin liquids, magnetic phases which lie outside the Landau paradigm, remains one of the central challenges for modern condensed matter physics. arxiv-2510-05237.title: Witten Effect in 3 3 -Form Description of θ \theta -vacua

arxiv-2510-05237.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Bachmaier ID, Gia Dvali, Juan Sebastián Valbuena-Bermúdez ID. The θ \theta -vacua of a gauge theory admit an equivalent formulation as vacua of a massless Chern-Simons 3 3 -form, which originate from the topological susceptibility of the vacuum. This formulation provides a framework in which the physical manifestations of the θ \theta -angle, which are quantum in origin, can be captured at the level of effective classical equations of motion.

pmc-11399612.description: SummaryPost-laser-assisted in situ keratomileusis (LASIK) corneal ectasia is a severe complication of corneal refractive surgery, and cryopreserved lenticules from hyperopic small incision lenticule extraction (SMILE) may offer a promising treatment though their long-term safety and efficacy are still under investigation.
